overview.title: The Lalbagh Glass House Mystery
overview.date_context: Set on August 31st, two weeks after the close of Lalbagh's annual Independence Day Flower Show (themed around the Western Ganga dynasty).
overview.location: The open lawn areas near the Glass House and Lalbagh Lake.
overview.victim: Basavanna, a meddlesome Bangalore socialite and gossip blogger.
overview.crime_scene: Basavanna’s broken black umbrella and spilled brass tumbler of filter coffee found near the lake path.
overview.murder_weapon: A curved sickle used for harvesting coconuts and garden maintenance.
overview.motive: The Coconut Vendor is secretly the Gandhinagar Diamond Smuggler, an old fugitive who fled custody in the late 1990s. Basavanna recognized their face from a recent Deccan Herald retrospective running on the 26th anniversary of Veerappan kidnapping Dr. Rajkumar and threatened to call the police that evening.

accessories.accessory: Handkerchief (in pocket but visible or tied around right wrist)
Smart Watch or Fitness Wristband on right wrist

wrist_wrap_red_herrings.note: Sweatband on right wrist (red herring for the tattoo clue).
Handkerchief visible or tied on right wrist (red herring for the tattoo clue).
Smart watch / fitness band on right wrist (red herring for the tattoo clue).
Cloth tied on right wrist — hides the criminal skull tattoo.

events: Basavanna confronts vendors near the North Gate fruit row with a newspaper clipping.
The College Botany Student sees The Overworked Flower Show Coordinator arguing with Basavanna near the Glass House.
The Lalbagh Lake Duck-Boat Operator sees The Wealthy NRI Investor sneak out of their car to hide a metal briefcase under an unattended fruit cart near the lake path.
The Maintenance Lawnmower Operator sees The Overworked Flower Show Coordinator trying to lock the maintenance shed from the outside.
Basavanna vanishes near the storage shed / lake path.
The Tender Coconut Vendor leaves their cart unattended for 20 minutes (seen by The Mango Stall Vendor).
The Self-Proclaimed Botanist hides wiped garden shears in a hollowed-out tree trunk (seen by The Sketch Artist).
The Tech Startup Founder is taking a board call near the Lotus Pond (heard screaming near the lake by The Filter Coffee Vendor).
The Street Photographer is changing camera lenses near the lake path.
The Marathon Runner leads a public stretch session on the grass opposite the hill (verified by The Yoga Instructor).
The Filter Coffee Vendor drinks tea at the West Gate stall with the Morning Walker Club (verified by The Morning Walker Club President).

gameplay_flow.name: Opening / Initial Alibis
steps: Gather in a circle. Read Round 1 Script.
Guests open envelopes, introduce characters, and state where they claim to have been at 3:30 PM.

gameplay_flow.name: Whisper Mingling
steps: Guests scatter across the lawn in groups of 2–3 and trade whisper clues.

gameplay_flow.name: Final Reveal
steps: Optional: brief debate and/or vote before the reveal.
Call everyone back. Read Round 3 Script (forensics + clear red herrings + name the killer).
Have The Tender Coconut Vendor confess.

setup: Print character cards, cut along dashed lines, and seal each inside an envelope labeled with the character title.
Give everyone a name tag with their character title (e.g., "The Tender Coconut Vendor").

Remind accessory guests to wear their props: Ankush (sweatband), Vivek (handkerchief), Shruti (smart watch/fitness band), Shriya (sunglasses on head), Shreya (cloth on right wrist), Rohit (hat), Naresh (tote bag).
Several right-wrist items exist so The Tender Coconut Vendor’s cloth wrap is not an obvious giveaway for the tattoo clue.

scripts.title: Round 1 — Opening
scripts.read_aloud:
Welcome to Lalbagh Botanical Garden! It’s August 31st, two weeks after the close of our Independence Day Flower Show and its Western Ganga dynasty displays. But a crime has taken place. Basavanna, our local socialite and gossip blogger, has vanished near the lake path—leaving behind only a broken black umbrella and a spilled tumbler of filter coffee. The culprit is standing in this circle right now.

Open your envelopes. Go around the circle, introduce your character, and state where you claim to have been at 3:30 PM today.

scripts.title: Round 2 — Whisper Mingling
scripts.read_aloud:
Listen up, everyone! No physical clues are hidden in the grass, but everyone here holds a critical piece of the story. You have 20 minutes to scatter across the lawn, form small gossip groups of 2 or 3, and trade your secret whisper clues.

Remember: only the true killer is allowed to lie when asked direct questions. Everyone else must tell the absolute truth about what they saw or heard!

scripts.title: Round 3 — The Final Reveal
scripts.read_aloud:
Time is up! The Inspector from the local police station just radioed in the official forensics report:

'Basavanna was attacked behind the storage shed with a curved fruit-cutting sickle stolen from the fruit stall crates.

Furthermore, evidence reveals Basavanna was carrying a Deccan Herald retrospective on famous Bangalore criminals published on the 26th anniversary of Veerappan kidnapping Rajkumar. That article exposed the true face of the Gandhinagar Diamond Smuggler—who carries a distinct skull tattoo on their right wrist!'

Before we name the killer, let's clear up our suspicious park visitors:

The NRI Investor was spotted sneaking out of their car to hide a metal briefcase of illegal land deeds underneath an unattended fruit cart.

The Botanist was caught hiding garden shears in a hollowed-out tree trunk after destroying smuggled orchids.

The Coordinator was locking the shed to hide broken Western Ganga display materials.

None of them committed the attack. Only ONE person was seen being confronted over the Deccan Herald article at a fruit cart, had an unattended stall at 3:30 PM, and wears a tight cloth wrap around their right wrist to hide their criminal tattoo: The Tender Coconut Vendor!

accusation_steps: Optional: give guests 3 minutes to debate theories and/or vote on paper.
Read Round 3 Script aloud to clear red herrings and name the killer.
Have The Tender Coconut Vendor step forward and confess.
